protocol.status: exploratory frozen-shortlist repair validation; no untouched holdout

ridge.selection: prior two calendar seasons; their own fits precede their validation season

protocol.profile_training: all prior available years; common rows for all features and both markets
protocol.elo_training: annual expanding from 2013; scoring from 2019; training-only RMS; no intercept
protocol.interval: paired four-week provider-match-day cluster t, calendar-week sensitivity
limits: Frozen pre-2019 feature constants and shortlist already selected on historical outcomes.
The dated-only history universe changes opposition, exposure and cohort as well as chronology.
Provider match days and same-event round order are not verified match-end or quote times.
Pointwise intervals do not adjust selection or establish independent calendar blocks.
Published bookmaker rows are not proven executable closing quotes; no returns measured.

definitions.profile: Original AP16 plus adjusted total-points form; frozen constants, rebuilt history
definitions.ratings: Fresh Elo/SR plus games-weighted Elo from repair_history rows
definitions.format: Scheduled edition metadata gates box history and iid targets; unsupported editions excluded from box history and iid predictions
definitions.surface: Fewer than three observed dated matches on surface this calendar season
definitions.load: log1p observed sets over prior 14 match-date days; missing historical totals mask load
definitions.age: A minus B age, and (age minus 25) squared difference; outside 14..50 missing

limitations: All undated matches omitted from history and targets
Workload and surface familiarity reflect the restricted observation universe
Provider dates with next-day availability assumption, not precise match-end timestamps
Match-day joins rely on retrospective source identity/score concordance
Frozen constants/short-IOS settings were selected in previously inspected research
